column3: NKJV has “His promise in Christ,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the promise in Christ Jesus.”

NKJV has “the fellowship of the mystery” and includes “through Jesus Christ,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the administration of the mystery” and lacks “through Jesus Christ.”
NKJV includes “of our Lord Jesus Christ,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text lacks it.
